title: Own JSON dependencies in test projects and extensions
goal: Declare the JSON dependencies used by tests, adapters and collectors; retain their runtime assets and verify VSTest discovery and execution when the platform stops providing Newtonsoft.Json.

selectionNotes: The dependency boundary is Test.Sdk/TestHost 18.7.0 versus 18.11.0, not a package-major-to-target mapping.
Target 10 requires deliberately adopting Test.Sdk 18.11.0; actual net10 execution is verified and the exact eight foundations are unchanged.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Actual Windows x64 test-host runtime: 10.0.13 or 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Exact observed pins are 10.0.402 and 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; runtime/runner selection is separate.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared sample language; the dependency remedy needs no newer language feature.

frameworks: Microsoft.NET.Sdk library tests and separately built managed VSTest adapter/collector.

packages.name: Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk
packages.reason: Current consumer; matching TestHost 18.11.0 lacks the old transitive Newtonsoft dependency.

packages.name: Newtonsoft.Json
packages.reason: Reviewed direct dependency in current tests and both extensions, with runtime assets and lock hashes retained.

packages.name: Microsoft.TestPlatform.ObjectModel
packages.reason: Compile-only platform contract for the paired extension projects; platform supplies its runtime assembly.

packages.name: Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI
packages.reason: Exact separately acquired managed runner; not an SDK-root release-build identity.

packageAssets: TestHost 18.7.0/18.11.0 select lib/net8.0 on both test targets; old TestHost directly requests Newtonsoft 13.0.3, new does not.
Newtonsoft 13.0.3 and 13.0.4 select lib/net6.0 compile/runtime; extensions explicitly ship 13.0.4. Full project locks record the complete closure.
Both measured CLI runner ZIPs contain contentFiles/any/net10.0/vstest.console.dll; its Major roll-forward allows the independently executed .NET11 lane.
platforms: Windows x64 compilation, managed discovery, test execution and collector loading verified; other OS/architectures and .NET Framework unverified.
prerequisites: SDK/runtime10 and SDK/runtime11 for paired reproduction; PowerShell7 and network for nuget.org acquisition.
Use VSTest explicitly in global.json. Microsoft.Testing.Platform RunnerTests are a separate route.
Fresh child CLI homes/caches with DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH=0; preserve PATH and persistent settings.
constraints: Declare and deploy JSON for every owning project. SDK-root Newtonsoft is not a project dependency; PrivateAssets and ExcludeAssets have different purposes.
Missing direct dependency fails CS0246; runtime-excluded test fails FileNotFoundException. Broken adapter discovery may exit zero with no tests; collector diagnostics must be checked.
The tiny adapter only handles WeatherTests.dll and its one named method. This is bounded packaging proof, not a production test framework.
CodeCoverage is present transitively but native coverage is not activated; only the original managed collector executes.
A Newtonsoft reference cannot restore removed communication APIs; no trimming, Native AOT, provider/device or cloud claim.
stabilityLimitations: .NET11 SDK/runtime proof is RC2, not actual GA reconciliation. No experimental API switch is required.
PIN-959 qualifying coverage/evidence and PIN-963 actual-GA reconciliation remain open.
